text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just like every year, a letter came from 
your old man.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"What do you want for your birthday?", he 
asks. ...I don't know what kind of 
connection our old men had, but he sure is 
dutiful about it every single year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Right. So, what are you going to ask 
for?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a kid anymore. I'll leave it to 
your old man's taste. I'm sure he'll send 
something classy and flawless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how modest. Were you always such a 
boring girl?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it's just that the 'things I want' 
aren't the kind of stuff the old man and 
the others can handle anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Why not try begging me for it? You might 
just get your hands on it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh? And what are you giving me, young 
lady?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The turf's wind, the heat, the 
frenzy——and, love.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You just want to run yourself, 
don't you?! Using someone's birthday as an 
excuse... what crazy passion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Still, what you truly desire is "that"... 
am I mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph, get ready and wait for me on the 
track.
